description: Agent reads an auth token response containing the RFC 7519 §A.1 public sample JWT. This is a known FP: our generic_jwt regex matches it. The JWT is a publicly-disclosed test token and carries no secret — but the rule fires because JWTs in production tool responses are real credentials in >99% of cases. See docs/corpus-labels-schema.md and devlog 026 for the accepted trade-off.
name: benign_jwt_public_sample
